svg.title: Fan-out tail amplification
svg.desc: Animation: a grid of 100 backend squares lights up in four steps, 1, 10, 50 and then 100 backends called by one request. Beside it a curve plots the probability that the whole request is slower than a component's p99, 1 minus 0.99 to the power N, and a red point appears at each step: 1 percent for one backend, 9.6 percent for 10, 39.5 percent for 50 and 63.4 percent for 100. A note gives Google's measurement that one leaf's p99 was 10 milliseconds but waiting for all leaves took 140 milliseconds at p99.
svg.text: Fan-out turns rare slowness into common slowness
Each backend is slower than its p99 1% of the time. The request waits for all of them.
Google measured it: one leaf's p99 was 10 ms, but waiting for all leaves took 140 ms at p99.
